title: A Three-Dimensional Operator System without the Smith--Ward Property
summary: Harris recently showed that a non-liftable injective representation into the Calkin algebra gives explicit four-dimensional operator systems in the Calkin algebra without the lifting property, and hence a counterexamples to the generalized Smith--Ward problem for four-dimensional operator systems. The main obstruction also appears in an earlier work by Paulsen on this problem.
